title: Knockout Shooting Game
description: A classic elimination shooting game where players chase the shooter in front of them, adding fun pressure to shooting practice and rewarding quick, confident shots.

content.objective: Take a quick, balanced shot under light pressure, and rebound and recover quickly, in a game everyone wants to play again.
content.setup: Players form a single line at the free-throw line. The first two players each have a ball. Everyone else waits in line, ready to move up.
instructions: The first player shoots. The second player, standing right behind, must shoot before the first player scores.
If the first player scores, they pass to the next player in line and the second player is safe and moves to the back of the line.
If the second player scores before the first player, the first player is knocked out and sits out for the round.
The player who shoots must rebound and pass to the next in line immediately.
Play until one player remains, then start a new round with everyone back in.
coachingPoints: Speed comes from quick footwork, not from a rushed release: set the feet, then shoot.
Rebound your own shot and pass immediately to keep the game moving.
Cheer for teammates who are knocked out and stay ready for the next round.
Follow through on every shot, even a quick one.
commonMistakes: Rushing a flat shot with no balance.
Waiting for the rebound instead of moving to the ball.
Standing on the wrong side of the lane and blocking a teammate.
content.safety: Keep the rebounders clear of the shooter and wait behind the line for your turn.
progressions: Shoot from the elbow or the wing to make the game harder.
regressions: Move the line closer to the basket and play with a single ball.
variations: Award a second life to a player who makes a swish.
